labels.actualLaborMinutesStandardShiftMinutes: Actual labor minutes / standard shift minutes over the period, against a configured standard shift length.
labels.availableVehicleCountPlannedTotalVehicle: Available Vehicle Count / Planned (Total) Vehicle Count x 100
labels.averageCreationCompletionTimeWorkOrders: Average creation-to-completion time for Work Orders completed in the period, weighted by daily completed count.
labels.averageTimePoOrderDateGoods: Average time from PO order date to goods receipt, over receipts posted in the period.
labels.averageTireCostPerKilometerTread: Average tire cost per kilometer of tread life, over tires removed in the period.
labels.breakdownsReportedPeriodPer100Vehicles: Breakdowns reported in the period per 100 vehicles in the fleet (fleet size taken as of the latest snapshot in the period).
labels.observedHoursBreakdownCountOverRolling: Observed hours / breakdown count over a rolling lookback window, as of the latest snapshot in the period. Descriptive reliability statistic, not a prediction.
labels.outStockCountTotalProductsTracked: Out Of Stock Count / Total Products Tracked x 100
labels.preventiveMaintenanceCountPreventiveCorr: Preventive Maintenance Count / (Preventive + Corrective + Breakdown) x 100
labels.repeatMaintenanceCountPreventiveCorrecti: Repeat Maintenance Count / (Preventive + Corrective + Breakdown) x 100
labels.scheduledMaintenanceCountOverdueMaintena: (Scheduled Maintenance Count - Overdue Maintenance) / Scheduled Maintenance Count x 100
labels.shareCompletedWorkOrdersWhoseAudit: Share of completed Work Orders whose audit trail shows a transition into REWORK status.
labels.shareCurrentlyScheduledMaintenanceNotOve: Share of currently-scheduled maintenance that is not overdue, as of the latest snapshot in the period.
labels.shareFleetActiveAvailableUseLatest: Share of the fleet that was ACTIVE (available for use) as of the latest snapshot in the period.
labels.shareMaintenanceActivityPeriodRepeatRepa: Share of maintenance activity in the period that was a repeat repair on the same vehicle/component group.
labels.shareMaintenanceWorkOrdersCompletedPerio: Share of maintenance Work Orders completed in the period that were PREVENTIVE.
labels.shareTrackedProductsZeroNegativeStock: Share of tracked products with zero (or negative) stock on hand, as of the latest snapshot in the period.
labels.shareVendorSReceiptsPeriodArrived: Share of a vendor's receipts in the period that arrived on or before the PO's expected delivery date.
labels.totalMaintenanceCostPeriodDividedFleet: Total maintenance cost in the period, divided by fleet size as of the latest snapshot in the period.
labels.totalMaintenanceCostPeriodDividedFleet2: Total maintenance cost in the period, divided by the fleet's total odometer reading as of the latest snapshot in the period (a current-odometer proxy, not a true period-distance delta).
labels.totalQualifyingRepairDurationNumberQuali: Total qualifying repair duration / number of qualifying repairs (COMPLETED/CLOSED Work Orders only), across the period.
labels.valueIssuedViaStockMovementsOver: Value issued via stock movements over the period, relative to the latest inventory value. A same-period foundation ratio, not an annualized turnover rate.
labels.workspaceOccupiedMinutesWorkspaceAvailab: Workspace-occupied minutes / workspace-available minutes over the period.
